WE ARE HIRING! 
 AI & TECHNOLOGY EXECUTIVE 
 Anjion Learning | EdTech 
 Anjion Learning is looking for a technically proficient, AI-driven professional who can manage, develop and optimise our digital infrastructure. We are seeking someone who can leverage emerging AI technologies, build high-converting landing pages, manage CRM systems and provide end-to-end technical support for our growing EdTech platform. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Website & Landing Page Development 
 * Design, develop and maintain responsive websites and landing pages. * Create high-converting course landing pages, registration pages and lead-generation funnels. * Work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and modern website development platforms. * Manage website hosting, domains, DNS, SSL certificates and basic server configurations. * Ensure website performance, responsiveness, SEO fundamentals and troubleshooting. 
 2. AI Tools & Automation 
 * Effectively utilise AI tools for content generation, workflow optimisation, research and business operations. * Work with AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and other emerging AI tools. * Implement AI-powered workflows and automation to improve organisational productivity. * Explore AI integrations for student support, lead management and educational operations. * Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks using AI. 
 3. CRM & Backend Management 
 * Manage and maintain CRM platforms and backend systems. * Handle lead management, lead allocation, follow-up automation and sales pipeline tracking. * Configure CRM workflows, triggers, integrations and automated notifications. * Maintain databases and ensure data accuracy and system efficiency. * Provide technical support to the sales, marketing and academic teams. 
 4. Technical Operations & Integrations 
 * Manage integrations between websites, CRM, payment gateways, WhatsApp APIs, email systems and other business tools. * Handle API integrations and troubleshoot technical issues. * Support LMS and online learning platform operations. * Coordinate with external developers and technical vendors. * Monitor website performance, security, backups and technical reliability. 
 5. Digital Infrastructure & Technical Support 
 * Provide end-to-end technical assistance to internal departments. * Identify and resolve software, website and system-related issues. * Manage Google Workspace, domain-related services and other digital business tools. * Research and implement new technologies that can improve organisational efficiency. 
 Required Technical Skills 
 * Website development and landing page creation. * HTML, CSS, JavaScript and basic programming knowledge. * WordPress or other website development platforms. * AI tools and prompt engineering. * CRM platforms and backend management. * Workflow automation tools such as Zapier, Make or n8n. * API integration and basic database management. * Knowledge of hosting, domains, DNS and website maintenance. * Familiarity with LMS platforms, payment gateways and digital marketing integrations. 
 Educational Qualification 
 * B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science Engineering, Information Technology or Computer Engineering preferred. * Candidates with relevant technical certifications and demonstrable practical expertise may also apply. 
 Experience 
 * Preferred: 13 years of relevant experience. * Freshers with strong technical knowledge, practical projects and demonstrable skills may also apply. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile 
 We are looking for someone who: 
 * Is passionate about emerging technologies and artificial intelligence. * Can independently develop and manage landing pages. * Has a strong problem-solving and troubleshooting mindset. * Can work across multiple technical platforms. * Is capable of managing both frontend requirements and backend operations. * Can translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Is proactive, innovative and willing to continuously learn new technologies. 
 What We Offer 
 * Opportunity to work with a growing EdTech organisation. * Exposure to AI-driven educational technology and digital innovation. * Opportunity to build and manage real-world technology projects. * A collaborative and growth-oriented working environment. * Career development and opportunities to take ownership of technical operations.

title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer, Data Collection
description:
Role: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer Location: Vashi, Navi Mumbai (4 days working from office) Work Timings: Work from office (12:00pm to 5:00pm) and then support remotely (7:30pm to 10:00pm) 
 As a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer within the Product organization, you will be responsible for solving most complex and challenging technical problems, and unlock delivery of value for services that power the PitchBook platform. You will be essential in applying your broad and deep experience in technology, problem solving abilities and ability to conduct hands on solution exploration and experimentation to guide technical teams, and enable them to build and release exceptional solutions relied upon and used by thousands of PitchBook customers every day; you will work with PitchBook professionals around the world with the collective goal of delighting our customers and growing our business. The teams will rely on your broad and deep experience in building and delivering comprehensive cloud solutions, and lean on your expertise in trade-off analysis and ability to identify options for the problems to solve and validate the right architecture and design with hands on. With your strong analytical skills, you’ll be able to break down abstract and complex problems into smaller problems and apply Domain Driven Design approaches such as identifying bounded contexts and establish decomposition process. You will be expected to devise solutions based on limited information and precedent to find creative ways to tackle challenges. It is essential that you will be able to interpret, assess and resolve a wide range of issues and be able to select the right course of action. You will collaborate with the PitchBook Architecture Team, as well as many internal stakeholders of different roles, backgrounds, who may have varying degrees of understanding of the domain. You may need to adapt your style of communication based on the audience you are interacting with and will be relied on to influence decisions to build optimal solutions to complex challenges. Additionally, as a technical expert in a broad set of domains, you will be expected to engage actively in promoting architecture guidelines, principles, and practices across team(s), and be a driver for consistency and alignment for cross cutting concerns. Lastly, you exhibit a growth mindset, willing to solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, and help create a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose. If you love building customer-centric solutions, strive for excellence every day, are adaptable and focused, and believe work should be fun, come join us! 
 Primary Job Responsibilities: Hands-on development will be a large part of the responsibilities. Quickly learn and trial hands on new technology, assess and validate assumptions, identify flows or risks that support the technical directions. Ensure qualities/non-functional requirements of the platforms and products are defined, measurable and are continuously evaluated to deliver the right product to our users. Document technical designs, communicate, elaborate with architects and other teams Implement well-designed, testable, and efficient code that meets product requirements, coding standards, performance, scalability, reliability, and the organization’s goals and principles, which can be used as reference implementation by other teams. Collaborate with other engineers, product managers, and other internal stakeholders in an Agile environment. Provide technical guidance with different team members. Design and deliver on end-to-end initiatives with little to no guidance. Define and participate in processes that improve products using return on experience, root cause analysis of incidents. Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors. Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested. Mentor and assist developing junior roles including Staff Software Development Engineers. 
 Skills and Qualifications: Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a similar field. Minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 4 years experience; or equivalent experience 8+ years in Software Development or Engineering roles. 6+ years of experience with Java or a similar object-oriented language. 4+ years of experience developing micro service. Experienced in Service-Oriented & Microservices Architecture, Cloud Architecture, Domain Driven Design (DDD), Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, Domain Driven Design Fluent in identifying and applying architecture patterns, designing RESTful API Have worked on middleware, platform, or system of systems. Experienced with web technologies and standards (e.g., JSON, JWT). Experienced with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Experienced in Spring Boot/Spring Framework. Experienced with Container orchestration software (e.g., Kubernetes). Highly experienced working within development teams in an Agile environment. Ability to handle a project through the entire software development lifecycle, end to end. Demonstrate ability to lead and/or provide guidance to junior peers across multiple teams. Excellent technical communication skills, written and verbal. Demonstrated strong problem-solving ability. Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite including in-depth knowledge of Outlook, Word and Excel with the ability to pick up new systems and software easily. 
 Working Conditions The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events. Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.

description:

 Job Title: Full Stack Developer – Microsoft Azure
 Experience: Senior Level: 10+ Years Intermediate Level: 4+ Years Work Location: Chennai / Bengaluru
 Work Mode: Hybrid
 Shift: UK Shift
 Notice Period: Immediate to 45 Days About the Organisation We are a technology-driven organisation specialising in insurance technology, enterprise software solutions and AI-powered digital platforms. The organisation is developing an advanced agentic AI platform designed to streamline insurance operations, including underwriting, claims processing, document management, finance operations and broker workflows. The platform uses AI agents to process information, prepare structured records, validate evidence and support business workflows while ensuring that critical decisions remain under the control of authorised professionals. The engineering team focuses on building secure, scalable and reliable cloud-based applications using Microsoft Azure, modern web technologies and AI-driven development practices. Job Summary We are looking for experienced Full Stack Developers with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, React.js, TypeScript and C#/.NET technologies. The selected candidates will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying and maintaining end-to-end applications across frontend, backend and cloud infrastructure. The role involves developing modern user interfaces, scalable backend APIs, cloud-based services, document-processing pipelines and AI-powered application capabilities. Candidates should have strong engineering fundamentals, hands-on cloud experience, excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently within a collaborative product engineering team. Key Responsibilities1. Full Stack Application Development Design, develop and maintain end-to-end full-stack applications. Build modern, responsive and user-friendly interfaces using React.js and TypeScript. Develop scalable backend services and APIs using C# and .NET / ASP.NET Core. Implement reusable components and maintain clean, modular and maintainable code. Work on application architecture, performance optimisation and debugging. 2. Backend Development and API Integration Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services. Implement authentication, authorisation and role-based access control. Develop relational database models and manage data using PostgreSQL or similar databases. Build background services, integrations and asynchronous processing workflows. Ensure secure and reliable communication between application components. 3. Microsoft Azure Cloud Development Develop, deploy and maintain production applications on Microsoft Azure. Work with Azure identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID. Implement cloud-based compute, storage, messaging and secrets management services. Configure application monitoring, logging and performance tracking. Maintain secure and scalable cloud environments. 4. AI and LLM Integration Integrate language-model capabilities into enterprise applications. Work with AI tools and services such as OpenAI and Anthropic. Implement tool calling, function calling and AI-driven workflow automation. Develop evidence validation, citation handling and structured data extraction capabilities. Implement AI evaluation, guardrails, permission checks and recovery mechanisms. 5. Infrastructure and DevOps Provision and maintain cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code. Work with Terraform for repeatable infrastructure deployment. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions. Use Docker for application development and local dependencies. Support deployment automation, environment configuration and release management. 6. Testing, Quality and Security Develop and maintain unit, integration, contract and end-to-end tests. Perform debugging, code reviews and application performance improvements. Ensure application security, data protection and secure coding practices. Implement secrets management and least-privilege access controls. Maintain technical documentation and follow engineering standards. 7. Collaboration and Product Development Collaborate with product managers, engineering teams and domain specialists. Convert business and product requirements into technical solutions. Participate in technical discussions, architecture decisions and code reviews. Support client demonstrations, technical evaluations and deployment activities. Maintain development documentation, reusable components and engineering guidelines. Essential Skills and ExperienceFrontend Development Strong hands-on experience with React.js. Good knowledge of TypeScript and modern JavaScript. Experience in component-based architecture and reusable UI development. Understanding of responsive design, accessibility and frontend testing. Backend Development Strong experience in C# and .NET / ASP.NET Core. Experience developing REST APIs and backend services. Good understanding of authentication, authorisation and application security. Experience with relational databases and data modelling. PostgreSQL experience is preferred. Microsoft Azure Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience running production workloads on Microsoft Azure. Experience with Azure compute, storage, messaging and identity services. Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, monitoring and secrets management. Ability to deploy, maintain and troubleshoot cloud-based applications. Python and Database Working knowledge of Python for document processing and data pipelines. Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server or other relational databases. Understanding of database design, queries and optimisation. DevOps and Infrastructure Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools. Knowledge of GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines. Hands-on experience with Docker. Understanding of automated deployment and release management. AI-Assisted Development Hands-on experience with AI-assisted or agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or comparable tools. Ability to use AI tools for code generation, refactoring, testing and debugging. Understanding of reviewing and validating AI-generated code. Ability to work with repository instructions, reusable development commands and AI-assisted engineering workflows. Testing and Communication Strong understanding of software testing methodologies. Experience writing automated tests alongside development. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to prepare technical specifications, documentation and clear code review comments. Strong analytical, problem-solving and debugging skills. Desirable Skills and Experience Insurance domain experience, particularly London Market and Lloyd's insurance. Knowledge of insurance underwriting, claims handling, policy wordings, broker placements and remittances. Experience with LLM application development using OpenAI or Anthropic. Experience with AI tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation frameworks and guardrails. Document-processing experience involving OCR, PDF parsing, layout extraction and email ingestion. Kubernetes on Azure (AKS) and Helm. Experience integrating with Guidewire PolicyCenter, Guidewire ClaimCenter or insurance pricing platforms. Experience managing single-tenant client environments and deployment acceptance. Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-204, AZ-305, AZ-400 or AI-102. Educational Qualification Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline. Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is an advantage. Candidate Profile Senior candidates should have 10+ years of professional software development experience. Intermediate candidates should have 4+ years of professional software development experience. Strong hands-on experience in full-stack application development. Good exposure to enterprise-level applications and cloud-based solutions. Ability to take ownership of features from design through deployment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Comfortable working independently and as part of a collaborative engineering team. Willingness to work in UK shift timings. Candidates should be available to join immediately or within 45 days.
